property_sets.name: Reviera_GlazingUnit
property_sets.description: A glazing build-up's light, thermal and safety values (spec ARC-GLZ-003), on glazing types: sloped glazing roof types and curtain wall types. Typical values come from Reviera's glazing library and are replaced by the specified product's.

properties.name: VisibleTransmittance
properties.description: Share of visible light the glazing lets through at normal incidence.

properties.name: ParTransmittance
properties.description: Share of photosynthetically active radiation (400–700 nm) let through, for crop-light analysis.

properties.name: Haze
properties.description: Share of the transmitted light that is diffused (horticultural diffuse glass, multiwall sheet).

properties.name: ThermalTransmittance
properties.description: Centre-of-pane U-value.

properties.name: SolarHeatGainCoefficient
properties.description: Total solar energy transmittance (g-value).

properties.name: SafetyClass
properties.description: How the glazing breaks.

properties.name: Interlayer
properties.description: A laminate's interlayer thickness (0.38 mm, 0.76 mm …).

properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: The glazing's overall thickness.

properties.name: MassPerArea
properties.description: Weight per area of glazing (stored with the per-length measure, as IFC has no per-area mass measure).

properties.name: MinimumPitch
properties.description: The least roof pitch the glazing is laid at.

properties.name: Structure
properties.description: Multiwall sheet's or film's structure: twin-wall, five-wall, multi-skin, single film, double inflated film.

property_sets.name: Reviera_FrameSystem
property_sets.description: A glazing frame system's material, glazing bar section and the deflection limit of its members carrying glass (spec ARC-GLZ-003), on frame types and on glazing types made on the frame. Typical values come from Reviera's frame library and are replaced by the specified system's.

properties.name: Material
properties.description: The members' material.

properties.name: Finish
properties.description: The members' finish (mill finish, anodised, hot-dip galvanised, stained, white …).

properties.name: BarWidth
properties.description: The glazing bar's width across the glazing's face.

properties.name: BarDepth
properties.description: The glazing bar's depth through the glazing.

properties.name: DeflectionRatio
properties.description: Members carrying glass deflect at most their span divided by this (175 for L/175).

properties.name: MaximumDeflection
properties.description: An absolute cap on that deflection, when the system sets one.

property_sets.name: Reviera_Vent
property_sets.description: A ventilation opening's design values (spec ARC-GLZ-004): on a vent window, that vent's; on a roof or curtain wall with vents, their count and totals. Free area is the opening of a top-hung sash at its design angle (the slot under it and its two side triangles, at most the pane); effective area is that times the discharge coefficient.

properties.name: OpeningAngle
properties.description: The design opening angle.

properties.name: DischargeCoefficient
properties.description: Effective over free area.

properties.name: Actuator
properties.description: How the vent is opened.

properties.name: FreeArea
properties.description: The geometric opening at the design angle (a host's: its vents' sum).

properties.name: EffectiveArea
properties.description: The free area times the discharge coefficient (a host's: its vents' sum).

properties.name: VentCount
properties.description: On a host: how many vents it has.

property_sets.name: Reviera_EnclosureDesign
property_sets.description: A glazed enclosure's design values (spec ARC-GLZ-001, -002), on its IfcElementAssembly (ObjectType GlazedEnclosure).

properties.name: Form
properties.description: The form.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Along the ridges.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Across the spans.

properties.name: Span
properties.description: Each roof's span (a Venlo's narrow roof).

properties.name: Spans
properties.description: How many roofs side by side.

properties.name: BaySpacing
properties.description: The bays along the length.

properties.name: EaveHeight
properties.description: The eave (gutter) height above the level; a tunnel's sidewall.

properties.name: RidgeHeight
properties.description: The highest ridge or crown above the level.

properties.name: Pitch
properties.description: The roof slope (not for tunnels).

properties.name: FloorArea
properties.description: Length times width.

properties.name: RoofVentTarget
properties.description: Roof vents' target area over the floor area.

properties.name: SideVentTarget
properties.description: Side vents' target area over the floor area.
